{{Top|leg}}
'''Security scanners''' were surveillance devices used in bases, prisons, factories, mines, laboratories, and other secure facilities to detect infiltrators or invaders.

==Description==
Security scanners were standard issue security devices used almost everywhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were ubiquitous, found in civilian structures such as stores and private homes, as well as governmental and military facilities including [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and [[Prison/Legends|prisons]]. The scanners ranged in complexity; from the inexpensive [[visual scanner]]s all the way up to complex and advanced [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorders]].<ref name="EGWT" />

Nearly all security scanners, except for the most inexpensive models, recorded images and audio and stored them on mediums such as [[Datacard/Legends|datacards]]. The units incorporated [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensor]] tracking programs that allowed the security scanners to follow an individual's movements. All of the information gathered by the security scanner was relayed into a central guard station. Automated functions could alert personnel to security concerns, and the scanners provided targeting data for automated [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] in military facilities.<ref name="EGWT" />

The scanners varied in size; smaller units could be made to fit inside a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] or [[Stylus/Legends|stylus]] although their video and audio quality was poor. Transmitters would relay their recordings to a connected recorder, using [[Signal scrambler|scramblers]] to disguise the signal. Larger units offered better clarity and range but were conspicuously visible.<ref name="EGWT" /> 

Security scanners could be equipped with a variety of systems, including magnification lenses to record activity [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away, and optics capable of seeing in the [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] and [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] spectrums.<ref name="EGWT" />

Security scanners ranged from the simple [[17C]] to the military-grade [[57C holocam]], both manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]]<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
Various types of security scanners were in use by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The basic two-dimensional camera was in use since at least the [[Jedi Civil War]] and for millennia after, a testament to its reliability. Other types of security scanners included motion sensors, infrared sensors, [[weapon detector]]s, and holographic recorders. These devices were usually small and unobtrusive, capable of being installed virtually anywhere. Some of the more sophisticated [[Holocamera/Legends|holocams]] could record video and audio data. Other scanners included precision scanners designed to rapidly turn, track, and zoom in on a target; ultraviolet and infrared security scanners for low-light environments; and long-range exterior scanners. Some scanners, albeit with a limited range, could be concealed in other devices such as [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] and [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]]. Some of the smallest scanners, with only audio-recording capabilities, could record conversations and movement in a certain area.

This type of equipment was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scanning crew/Legends|scanning crew]] that inspected the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].

Security scanners could be linked to hidden [[R-TechApp Man Trap]]s integrated into security systems. The scanners could remotely activate the traps when an intruder was detected.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
